description:
List the files attached to one element (`type` and `id`, a UUID) in the
world named by your API-Key header: PDFs, text files, images (png, jpg, webp,
avif) and world bundles kept on onlyworlds.com beside the element, never
inside it.

Returns `{data: [{id, name, kind, size, label, added_by, added_at}, ...]}`,
newest first. `label` is the field the file belongs to, free text, or null;
`added_by` says who added it, whether an agent did, and whether the
world's current owner did (`owner`, true or false). `membership` is null
for the owner's files and for a file whose membership no longer exists;
`owner` tells the two apart. A file with a null `membership` and `owner`
false is named "a former member". A removed member's file keeps its
membership id and name; a file whose member's account was deleted keeps
its membership id and is named "a former member". You see a file
exactly when you may see its element. Read a text file's words with
`read_file(file_id)`. Requires a READ or WRITE API-Key.

world.description: The world to read, by id or by its public page's slug. With an API-Key, leave it out (or name the key's own world by its id): a key reads its own world only. list_worlds names the worlds you can read here.

name: list_files
